issue.title: test_sudo_local_flow_never_persists_canary_credentials flakes under the full just check lane, passes in isolation
issue.description: Proposed by sase-17m.5.1.6.5.1 (PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP #1) while landing the retry-session visual repair. Details are in the flake report below.

task_type_fields.evidence:
On 2026-09-25, sase-17m.5.1.6.5.1 ran just check and the full suite reported 47365 passed with 3 load-flaky failures. This node was one of them. The same node then passed in isolation on that unchanged tree. Fail rate was not measured; no serial root-cause repro was attempted. The change under verification was a retry-session visual query/golden repair and cannot touch sudo credential persistence.

Do not +1 retired umbrella sase-ct. Re-measure with just test-contention.
